$comment: Upstream source of truth for QA test-scenario DEFINITIONS across product surfaces. The private Google Sheet 'Green Goods v1.1 QA' is the live defect log and team run ledger; generated xlsx workbooks (bun run qa:workbook -> tmp/qa/) are per-run working artifacts. Results, owners, defect links, and PostHog data never enter this file or git (public repo). Consumed by scripts/agents/qa-workbook-build.ts and the qa-session skill. IDs are never reused: set status 'retired' instead of deleting. steps[] joins with '; ' in generated sheets. requiresProduction marks cases that cannot run on localhost dev (production origin installs, passkey RP-ID ceremonies).
